title: Crispy Duck Fry
description: A simple, flavorful dish combining crispy duck with a side of fried fix and syrian spices.

ingredients.name: Syrian spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of oregano, cumin and coriander

instructions: 2. Season the duck breast with salt, black pepper, and Syrian spices.
3. Heat the quick oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the duck breast until browned on both sides, then transfer to the oven and roast for 20 minutes.
5. While the duck is cooking, heat the fix in a separate skillet over medium heat until crispy.
6. Remove the duck from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
7. Slice the duck into thin strips and serve with the crispy fix and garnish with parsley.
8. Drizzle with lemon juice and serve immediately.
